Earlier this year, Unilever announced an agreement to combine its Foods business with McCormick & Company, creating a scaled global flavor powerhouse. The proposed combination would bring together iconic Foods brands, including Hellmann’s and Knorr, with McCormick’s portfolio to create a global leader across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by strong retail and foodservice platforms. McCormick brings more than 135 years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, with completion estimated for mid-2027.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are eager to drive Unilever Supply Chain Finance performance to next level, then this role is just for you!

Main Responsibilities

- Partnering with factory team to drive Financial KPI target achievement (ie. CPT/Cost per Ton) & financial control compliance
- Leading financial process for factory related but not limited to:
- Monthly rolling COGP forecast
- Savings tracking and governance
- Month end closing, including cost variance analysis
- Annual business planning
- Leading factory related business cases – working with multifunctional team
- Leading performance management and process improvement related to production cost central charges.
- Play key role in highlighting risk and opportunities in factory saving
- Ensure supply chain control in place as per Unilever design in Factory area

Candidate Criteria

Experience & Qualification
- Finance/Accounting Education Background
- Fresh Graduate / Professional with 1-2 years of experience in finance

Skill
- Enjoys solving issues and possesses an inquisitive mind, constantly looking out for better ways of working
- Works well under pressure, organized, meticulous, motivated and as well as team-player
- Able to handle different tasks/projects and stakeholders simultaneously
- Basic understanding of Unilever P&L

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 31 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market.

Responsibilites :

• Submit the investigation report progress stepwise and timely, to ensure that all working activities are carried out safely by complying with all procedures, Law or Others Regulations applicable requirements related to occupational safety.
• Coordinate with SHE Operation Department in maintaining ISO 45001 compliance in SHE Division.
• Coordinate with CSP2 section, CSP3 section and SHE Operation Department in conducting SHE Culture/Promotion Program.
• Involved in incident investigation meeting as facilitator; provide the incident investigation report and Lesson Learn report; monitor the follow up of corrective action report and preventive action report.
• Involved in PSM audit, HIRADC audit; provide its finding report; and monitor the follow up of corrective action report and preventive action report.
• Assist internal audit with the auditor of the company such as: Quality Assurance Section, or from outside companies such as: insurance, certification bodies, government, etc.
• Coordinate with HR for worker training in areas such as required by SHE laws and regulations.

Qualifications :

• Minimum Bachelor Degree in major Chemical Engineering.
• Minimum 5 years experience in handling compliance and incident investigation or related field.
• Strong understanding of process manufacturing equipment, device and analysis for problem solving.
• Experience with continous improvement intended to assure that effective program are in place for identifying, eliminating, or controlling hazards that could adversely impact a company's physical and human assets.
• Hold certification SMK3 Auditor, ISO 45001, Accident/Incident Investigation from IOSH and General OSH expert from Kemnaker.
• Fluent in English both spoken & written.

This position will be placed in site office Cilegon.

The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview.
